title: Shared Worktree Apply Merge
description: 🔀️ The three-way line merge the replica applies when an inbound event meets an unpublished local edit of the same path: `base` is the content the replica last applied at the path, `ours` the local bytes, `theirs` the inbound content. `merged` is the clean merge, or null when the sides conflict (they change overlapping or touching lines differently) or cannot be merged (binary content). Every vector agrees with `git merge-file -p ours base theirs`.
